name: Bartholomew Vance
title: now a golden retriever in Ohio
text: Appeal upheld. I have been called a good boy four times today. Please never audit this.

name: Ines R.
title: now a maple tree in Vermont
text: Very quiet here. A woodpecker rents a room in me. I allowed it.

name: Captain Reyes
title: now a harbor pilot in Lisbon
text: Same crew, new ocean, zero icebergs. I check the water for ice anyway. Old habits.

name: Soul #70070
title: now living in a one-story bungalow
text: Fewer stairs, as requested. Zero stairs, actually. I stood in the hallway and cried a little.

name: Soul #24680
title: now a baker’s apprentice in Lyon
text: The bread is excellent. I may be the bread now. Hard to say, I am very warm.

name: Old Man Hutchins
title: now a tortoise on a very slow island
text: Still holding the grudge. Should be finished with it in about ninety years.

name: Soul #33333
title: now a cat in Osaka
text: Received your welcome letter. Sat on it. Regards.

name: Dr. Lindqvist
title: now a lighthouse keeper in Maine
text: Process reviewed. Reviewer Two was me. Reviewer Two was wrong.

name: Priya M.
title: now a librarian in Pune
text: I got the quiet part again. Someone coughed. I forgave them. Growth.

name: Soul #45454
title: now four years old, and in a hurry
text: They say you cannot skip this part. I am watching a cartoon about trucks. I have notes.

name: Soul #56565
title: now a travel agent in Perth
text: Karma did not carry over. My unused leave did. I am on a beach. Do not call.

name: Grandma Liu
title: now the neighbor next door to her grandson
text: I watch him from the porch. He eats well. He does not call. Please fix this.

name: Soul #78787
title: now a sommelier in Napa
text: You surprised me! I listed forty conditions and you met thirty-nine. The last one was a view. Fair.

name: Marcus D.
title: now a lake in Minnesota
text: Less thinking, as ordered. Only ripples. Absolute bliss. Do not send follow-up questions.

name: Soul #61234
title: now a cactus farmer in Arizona
text: No hoses. We use a bucket. The bucket and I have an understanding.

name: Mr. Alderman
title: now a tea-sandwich chef in Bath
text: Small bites, as requested. Everyone is proud of me. The sandwiches are the size of a stamp.

name: Soul #40871
title: now a couch designer in Milan
text: Better couches. Nothing lives behind them. The remote is in my hand, where it belongs.

name: Ms. Byakov
title: now a shopping cart in Tulsa
text: Wheel number three squeaks. I roll where I want. Nobody has told me otherwise.

name: Soul #71029
title: now a beekeeper in Slovenia
text: Allergic to nothing. The bees have noticed. They respect it.

name: Mr. Calloway
title: now a finished bookshelf in Malmö
text: Arrived pre-assembled. A man keeps trying to take me apart. I said no.

name: Soul #90234
title: now a figure skater in Calgary
text: Much better traction. I fell once. On purpose. The crowd loved it.

name: Ms. Devries
title: now a copy editor in Dublin
text: I spell perfectly now. I have never been so angry about a comma.

name: Soul #55671
title: now a sloth caretaker in Costa Rica
text: A slower life, as requested. I am typing this postcard from last Tuesday.

name: Mr. Godoy
title: now a park ranger in Oregon
text: Very cautious now. I test every hammock before anyone sits. I weigh nothing. The test is unclear.

name: Soul #12456
title: now a sneaker designer in Portland
text: It is all Velcro. Rrrrip. Every morning. I have never been happier.

name: Ms. Halversen
title: now the vending machine technician in Leeds
text: I won this time. The machine knows. We do not speak of it. Snacks for everyone.

name: Soul #78341
title: now a very confident toddler in Austin
text: Training wheels forever. I am the fastest person on my street. Do not tell the dog.

name: Ms. Jarocki
title: now a ground marshal at Warsaw airport
text: Spatial sense: excellent. I park airplanes. Nobody has complained. Not yet.

name: Soul #45671
title: now a cashier in a store with no machines
text: A human scanned my banana. We locked eyes. It was beautiful.

name: Mr. Kowalenko
title: now a pastry chef in Krakow
text: Two cakes, every day. I eat one. I admire the other. That is balance.

name: Ms. Lindqvist
title: now an architect in Helsinki
text: A life without ladders. I design only ramps. The neighbors adore us.

name: Soul #33019
title: now a cactus, a very loved cactus
text: Someone waters me every other week. Perfect. I am thriving and slightly smug.

name: Midnight the black cat
title: now a barn cat with nine lives, one already used
text: Nine more lives, starting now. Used one already. I should not have tested the stove.

name: Ollie the corgi
title: now a corgi with longer legs, supposedly
text: Caught the mail van. Now what? I do not know. Barking at it to be safe.

name: Sheldon the turtle
title: now a hare in Wyoming
text: Fast. So fast. I forgot I was famous for the other thing.

name: Chorizo the dachshund
title: now living in a shipping container in Rotterdam
text: Bigger box, as requested. Considering a warehouse next. Do not rush me.

name: Coco the poodle
title: now a throw pillow in Brooklyn
text: I am the lap now. Someone naps on me every afternoon. A fair trade.

name: Ziggy the ferret
title: now a ferret with fewer socks and more naps
text: I have a tiny hammock and a tiny pillow. I am doing extremely well.

name: The Bodhisattva
title: now on a very long, very quiet vacation
text: I left for the pension. Then I came back for the pension. The cycle continues. Please water the plant.

name: Soul #19191
title: now living the same life, with different numbers
text: Same life, same ticket shop. The numbers lost again. Honestly? Charming.

name: Soul #67676
title: now six foot four, in Sacramento
text: I am tall. Everything is on the top shelf, which is where I live now. Nobody asked me.

name: The Bodhisattva’s nephew
title: now an intern in Zurich
text: No discount applied. Uncle says hello. Uncle also says no.
